name: Mizusaka Ren
source:
[spoiler]Aka Leviathan (リバイアサン). [/spoiler]
No one knows where she came from, yet she exists in cyber space. She seems to have some unknown relationship with Tooru. [spoiler]Tooru's stepsister, she died in an old military lab as an experiment of the "Brain Project" when Tooru was younger (around 12 years old).[/spoiler]
